description: This bar chart illustrates the performance gain in percentage points (+%) achieved under two different supervision regimes—Strong Supervision (represented by blue bars with diagonal stripes) and Weak Supervision (represented by solid light blue bars)—for three distinct large vision-language models: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical y-axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks and gridlines at intervals of 5. The horizontal x-axis lists the three model names in order from left to right. For each model, there are two adjacent bars: the left bar represents Strong Supervision and the right bar represents Weak Supervision. The performance gain for Strong Supervision is significantly higher than for Weak Supervision in all three cases. Specifically, for GPT-4o, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 24.5%, while the Weak Supervision bar is at approximately 5.5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the Strong Supervision bar is approximately 9.5%, and the Weak Supervision bar is approximately 3.5%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the Strong Supervision bar is approximately 15%, and the Weak Supervision bar is approximately 5.5%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis. There are no visual emphasis elements such as shading or bolding beyond the inherent color and pattern coding defined in the legend.
